flows.title: Create a task
steps: From the toolbar, click Create task.
Name the task, and add any optional task details.

flows.title: Search the Workspace
steps: Press Cmd + K on Mac or Ctrl + K on PC, or click Search in the toolbar, to open the AI Command Bar and search tasks, messages and Docs.
To search inside one view, such as List, Board or Table, click the magnifying glass icon in the upper-right of the view and type keywords. Results appear as you type.

flows.title: Move a task to another List
steps: From a view, click the task's ellipsis (...) icon.
Search or browse to select a List. To keep it in its current List as well, check Move and keep in current List in the lower-left corner.
